purpose: Phase-8A microenvironment-mediated protection. Reduced response caused by ECM restriction / poor penetration / hypoxia / low perfusion / vascular heterogeneity / spatial limitation - consumed READ-ONLY from the Phase-7A passive-microenvironment and Phase-7B vascular engines. It must remain DISTINGUISHABLE from cell-intrinsic resistance: protection is a delivery/accessibility limitation, not acquired resistance, and is NOT double-counted with effective exposure. Schematic ordinal only.

coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic microenvironment protection the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: Phase-7A penetration modifier + Phase-7B delivery modifier (read-only), mapped predictively to protection
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: derived from upstream 7A/7B outputs; if those already reduced effective exposure, the double-counting guard prevents re-application.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No absolute penetration depth, pO2, or perfusion rate (all NOT_REPORTED).

rules.not_intrinsic_resistance: Microenvironment protection is recorded as a delivery/accessibility limitation, distinct from cell-intrinsic resistance.
rules.no_double_count: If 7A penetration / 7B delivery already reduced effective exposure, protection is not re-applied to the same exposure channel.
